name: dx-vif-resilience
description: Assess Layer-3 (BGP prefix) failover resilience across redundant AWS Direct Connect virtual interfaces. Use when the user asks whether their Direct Connect setup is resilient, whether failover will work, whether the same routes/prefixes are advertised across redundant VIFs, why traffic was lost after a VIF or connection failure, or to audit DX BGP route symmetry. Checks both directions (routes received from on-prem and routes advertised by AWS) using the ListVirtualInterfaceRoutes API and the deterministic dx-resilience-mcp analysis tools. Read-only: analysis and recommendations only, never configuration changes. Complements Layer-1/2 checks (redundant connections, diverse locations/devices) — this skill covers what those miss.
